page.title: Simulation Templates
page.description: Apply a curated ruleset to your server, or save your own configuration to reuse later.

noTemplates.title: No templates yet
noTemplates.description: Save your current server configuration as a template, or import one from a file.

createDialog.title: Save Current Config as Template
createDialog.description: Captures this server's current server.ini and sandbox settings.
createDialog.willSaveMessage: Will save {{sandboxCount}} sandbox setting(s) and {{iniCount}} server.ini key(s). Identity and connection settings (name, ports, passwords) are never included.

importDialog.title: Import Template
importDialog.description: Paste a .pztemplate.json file's contents, or pick a file below.

previewDialog.noActiveServerDesc: Set up a server before previewing or applying templates.
previewDialog.remoteServerDesc: Applying templates to remote servers isn't supported yet.

diffList.modsEmpty: This template doesn't reference any mods.
diffList.modsAutoInstall: Referenced mods aren't installed automatically — add them from the Mod Manager.

applyPanel.successMessage: {{iniCount}} INI key(s) updated. {{sandboxCount}} sandbox setting(s) updated. {{backupCount}} backup file(s) created. Changes will take effect the next time the server restarts.
applyPanel.runningDesc: Files will be updated now, but the running server won't pick up the changes until it's restarted.
